svg.title: S5 — Busiest airports (US210) from Flight Routes events, without HTTP

g.text: S5 — Busiest airports (US210) from Flight Routes events, without HTTP
upsert by routeId (idempotent, stale versions ignored)
(a route counts for origin and destination)
sort by count desc, then IATA; top 3
Replaces the HTTP bridge B5: Airports answers even while Flight Routes is down, with the routes it already knows.
The queue is durable: events published while Airports is down wait there.
Routes published before the queue existed are not received (Flight Routes has no replay yet).
